errors.evidence: The description incorrectly assigns the annotated values to the wrong years. The values 58.7, 68.1, and 62.9 correspond to the years 2019, 2021, and 2023, respectively, not 2018, 2020, and 2022 as stated. The chart contains one bar for each year, but the x-axis labels are only shown for even years, which likely caused the confusion.

errors.text_span: Die Balken sind in einem einheitlichen hellblauen Farbton gehalten
errors.evidence: This statement is inaccurate and contradicts a later part of the description which correctly states 'Einige Balken weisen eine leichtere Farbgebung auf' (Some bars have a lighter color). The bars for the last few years of the chart are visibly lighter.
